name: How long does a typical door lock repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door lock repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a door lock repair can vary based on the complexity of the issue and the type of lock. Simple repairs, such as adjusting a strike plate or lubricating a stiff mechanism, might take as little as 30 minutes to an hour. More complex problems, like replacing internal components or addressing damage from attempted forced entry, could take 1-3 hours. A professional technician can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing the specific lock problem.
